thread:
Dana: FYI SI partner NexusIntegrate reported a billing mismatch: usage from tenant child accounts is being billed to the parent org. They noticed it after switching to the new forwarder. Ticket: https://nexus.support/PR-900
Olive: do they send tenant_id vs org_id in the payload?
Dana: their new forwarder rewrites customer_id to the org root if missing tenant metadata. sample payload pasted in ticket shows customer_id=org-789 and tenant_tag=tenant-44 in headers only.
Hector: our ingestion uses customer_id field for ledger key. if tenant metadata is only in headers we ignore it for aggregation. that's the bug.
Olive: quick mitigation? we can accept tenant header for a short window and treat header+payload combo as canonical when present. but need to be careful about spoofing.
Hector: security note: require HMAC on header metadata or signed manifest. if partner upgrades forwarder to include tenant_id in body we avoid header trust.
Dana: billing-bot can you scan how many unique customers were billed to org-789 in last 45 days that have tenant headers present?
billing-bot: Query queued: SELECT DISTINCT header_tenant FROM marketplace_usage WHERE partner='nexus' AND received_at >= '2026-01-10' AND billed_to_org='org-789' AND header_tenant IS NOT NULL; estimated rows: 54 tenant ids found
Olive: ok that's sizeable. Proposal: 1) short-term accept tenant header when signature verifies; 2) mark windows where header != payload_customer as 'attribution_review' and don't auto-issue credits. 3) run backfill to re-attribute prior windows where headers existed and signature validates.
Hector: implementation detail: add attribute source_priority = [payload.customer_id, header.tenant_id] and ledger key computed from first non-null. Also add provenance fields so we can audit.
Dana: operations: add alert rule if more than 0.5% of partner's hourly windows require attribution_review. ops-bot can you create that?
ops-bot: Alert rule created: partnerships.attribution.review_rate > 0.5% for partner=nexus; notify #partnerships-alerts and open incident if threshold exceeded.
Olive: for partner comms: ask Nexus to stop rewriting customer_id and instead send tenant_id inside payload in next forwarder release. Offer a 30-day acceptance period for header-based replays with signed manifests.
Dana: billing-side: don't auto-credit yet. we'll produce a proposed corrections report for Nexus and affected customers; finance will approve prior to issuing credits.
Hector: I'll land a small PR to accept header-tenant if hmac_header present and set attribution_review flag. Also write migration note in runbook with sample payloads.
billing-bot: Action items recorded: ["Hector: PR for header-tenant acceptance","Dana: partner comms + corrections report","Olive: runback plan + timeline","ops-bot: alert created"].
Dana: thanks team. we'll update Nexus and schedule a joint replay window next week for replays across the 54 tenants.
